note: Deterministic software fixtures for quality-gate regression tests. Synthetic RGB only: these are NOT physiological recordings and cannot support any accuracy claim.

clean_72bpm.description: baseline single 1.2 Hz pulse in three ROIs; expected to pass gates

second_pulse_competing.description: equal competing component 0.4 Hz from the pulse; peak separation must fail

no_pulse_noise.description: broadband noise, no cardiac component; concentration must fail

clipped_channels.description: saturated red/green channels; clipping check must fail

flat_channel.description: constant green channel; dynamic-range check must fail

illumination_step.description: 22-count brightness step mid-window; must not be reported as a clean measurement

motion_burst.description: 3 s 2.7 Hz excursion; motion/noise handling must reject or flag

missing_roi_samples.description: left cheek absent 5-12 s; per-ROI coverage must reflect it
